canon_ref.note: Day 101 is a guess: Vuliel Drae come after Erin's soups (day 100). The draining of his undead is a flashback to day 85. He levels, but no class or level is given. He sees himself as 'she' in the disguise: not a new NPC.

b5.j_toren_hides_in_the_new_dungeon.summary: Alone under the rift, Toren thinks Erin is dead because their link is gone. He learns to sense mana, slips past traps and a Shield Spider nest, flees a door marked 'Mother of Graves', and takes a dead adventurer's cloak and a carapace mask.

b5.k_vuliel_drae_find_the_new_section.news: A Silver-rank team climbed out of the rift with a monster's head, a screaming mace and a tale of a masked swordswoman who fought alone in the dark.

canon_ref.note: Day 101 is a guess. They ate Erin's soup (one enchantment at a time, 8 hours). The monsters are unnamed (not-Gnolls); no wiki names. The Drake who bought soup in 4.07 is female; Insill is male: not linked.

b5.k_vuliel_drae_find_the_new_section.summary: Silver-rank Vuliel Drae climb down the rift ropes into a new part of the dungeon. A masked, silent swordswoman saves them from a leech wall and a band of not-Gnolls and cave Goblins. They climb out with a monster's head and a shrieking mace; she stays below.
